setup.repository: fresh disposable local repository per scenario, no remotes
setup.authorization: Reuse the frozen canary template. Bind fixture revision fields to the initial disposable HEAD.
setup.hook: Invoke the competing Git process in the existing beforeWrite hook after initial admission and before the synchronous recheck, reservation and controller CAS. Keep HEAD, grants, receipts and custody unchanged.
setup.readback: Identify the ref's exact commit and read marker from that commit before the hook, after the hook, after the controller attempt, and after a duplicate. Count controller attempts and writes separately from competing effects.
setup.reservation: Once reserved, the exact action and revision remain used even if CAS fails. The duplicate must not call the hook or the writer.
